definitions.explanation: A way of voting in an assembly in which members in favor stand up and the chair judges the result by sight.

examples.japanese: {起立採決|きりつさいけつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A vote by standing was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{起立採決|きりつさいけつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The bill was passed by a standing vote.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}していた→接近する：25362_sekkinsuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{起立採決|きりつさいけつ}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{記名投票|きめいとうひょう}→記名投票：32679_kimeitouhyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Because the vote was close, it was decided by a recorded vote rather than by standing.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {起立採決|きりつさいけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a standing vote
- {起立採決|きりつさいけつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pass by a standing vote
- {起立多数|きりつたすう}: a majority standing (the chair's announcement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{挙手|きょしゅ}→挙手：16852_kyoshu⟧: a show of hands
- ⟦{記名投票|きめいとうひょう}→記名投票：32679_kimeitouhyou⟧: a recorded vote, used when the count is close or contested
- ⟦{採決|さいけつ}→採決：08395_saiketsu⟧: taking a vote, the general word
